ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of pizza-style slice, golden-orange crust edge with browned bubbles, pale melted cheese with orange-red sauce spots and patches, sits at upper left of plate, about 12 cm long by 5 cm wide, roughly 1.5 cm thick, slightly oily sheen on cheese | 110

ITEM 2 | Cooked broccoli florets, bright to dark green with some yellowish-green tips, firm and slightly glossy, small clustered florets with stems, about 3 to 4 cm across each, dry surface with no visible sauce, grouped in center-bottom of plate | 70

ITEM 3 | Cooked meat pieces, pale tan to brown with darker browned edges and grayish-brown interior, fibrous shredded or sliced texture, moist look with slight sheen, arranged in an irregular cluster about 8 cm by 5 cm, about 2 cm thick, sits at upper right of plate | 95
